name: I Can T Believe It Is Butter  Margarine Spread
instructions: If you make your own buttermilk , mix vinegar to milk and let it stand at least 20 minutes and stir
In large mixing bowl , add softened margarine , buttermilk , vegetable oil and butter buds flavoring
Mix on slow speed until well mixed
Put in a container with lid in refrigerator
Preparation time includes making your own buttermilk
